title: althaea rugosa
intro: Althaea rugosa, commonly known as the rugosa marshmallow, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Malvaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating digestive issues, sore throats, and skin irritations due to its anti-inflammatory, soothing, and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Althaea rugosa are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include mucilage production, anti-oxidation, and anti-inflammatory responses, thanks to its bioactive constituents such as mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Althaea rugosa plant contribute to its therapeutic properties, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions.
